goals.description: Determine whether the request names a specific test or only a package path; if a test name is provided, identify the package containing it so the correct go test command can be formed.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on resolving the test target from the user's request. Decide whether you have a package path, a specific test name, or both. If only a test name is provided, locate the package containing that test before moving on.
goals.name: resolve test target

goals.description: Ensure the PostgreSQL Docker container for unit tests is running, wait until it accepts connections, and create the test database needed by the tests.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on preparing PostgreSQL for the test run. Check for the storj_unit_tests_postgres container, start it if needed on port 5433 with the expected password, wait for readiness, and ensure the teststorj database exists or is created.
goals.name: prepare PostgreSQL container

goals.description: Run the requested Go tests with the PostgreSQL test database connection string configured.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on executing the resolved Go test command. Include the PostgreSQL test database flag using postgres://postgres:tmppass@localhost:5433/teststorj?sslmode=disable, and include -run only when a specific test was requested.
goals.name: run PostgreSQL tests

goals.description: Summarize whether the tests passed or failed, list the subtests that ran, and if failures occurred, offer to help investigate them.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on reporting the outcome of the completed test run. State pass/fail clearly, include the subtests that ran when available from the output, and offer follow-up investigation for any failures.
goals.name: report test results

goals.description: Remove the PostgreSQL Docker container used for the test run after tests are complete.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on cleanup. Stop and remove the storj_unit_tests_postgres Docker container now that the PostgreSQL-backed tests have completed.
goals.name: stop PostgreSQL container
